title: Intervention Sample Planner Study Configuration
description: JSON Schema for local Intervention Sample Planner configuration files. File version 1.0; date 2026-05-11.

$schema.description: Optional schema URI or relative path used by editors and validators.

_file_version.description: Metadata for the version of this JSON file format.

_file_date.description: Metadata date for this JSON file format.

study_name.description: Short study name used in saved files and reports.

language.description: Language used by the interface/report when this configuration is loaded.

analysis_unit.description: Unit about which the conclusion is made.

observation_unit.description: Unit from which data are collected.

outcome_type.description: Primary outcome type. Continuous uses two independent means; binary uses two independent proportions.

alternative.description: Hypothesis direction used to choose the alpha quantile.

alpha.description: Type I error risk before Bonferroni adjustment.

primary_comparisons.description: Number of planned primary comparisons for Bonferroni alpha adjustment.

effect_size_d.description: Cohen's d for continuous outcomes. May be null if raw means plus pooled SD are provided.

mean_control.description: Optional expected control mean for documentation or effect-size calculation.

mean_intervention.description: Optional expected intervention mean for documentation or effect-size calculation.

sd_pooled.description: Optional pooled standard deviation. Required if effect_size_d is null and raw means are used.

proportion_control.description: Expected control-group proportion for binary outcomes.

proportion_intervention.description: Expected intervention-group proportion for binary outcomes.

finite_population.description: Known closed population size when finite-population correction is used.

cluster_average_size.description: Average number of people per cluster/class/group.

intraclass_correlation.description: Intraclass correlation used for design-effect correction.

response_rate.description: Share of invited people expected to start or accept.

completion_rate.description: Share of assigned/starters expected to complete the study.

usable_data_rate.description: Share of completed cases expected to provide valid analyzable data.

intervention_label.description: Label used for the intervention group in reports.

control_label.description: Label used for the control group in reports.

notes.description: Free notes about assumptions, literature sources, pilot data, or limitations.

source_case.description: Optional metadata block used by source-based examples and tests.
